title: A king's move never creates a chase
rationale: The companion meaningful negative to mx-chs-018 for the other excluded attacker: the white king genuinely attacks the undefended black cannon after each of its moves — d2 attacks d3 and c2 attacks c3, and the capture is legal — and the same shuttle driven by a chariot is a perpetual chase. A king takes no part in the chase rule as a chasing piece, so only the attacker-class rule produces the neutral repetition.
